UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 2031 
 ANSWERED ON- 12.03.2021 
  
EFFICIENCY OF FOOD PROCESSING SECTOR 
  
2031.   DR. AMEE YAJNIK: 
  
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
  
(a) the details of agricultural and food products being processed in the country; 
  
(b) whether the country’s share in the international food trade is very low and if so, the  
details thereof and the steps taken to improve it; 
 
(c) whether the country’s food processing industry is highly fragmented and dominated by 
the unorganised sector and if so, the details thereof and the corrective measures taken by 
Government in this regard; and 
 
(d) the steps taken/proposed to be taken by Government to increase the efficienc y of the  
food processing sector in the country? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI RAMESWAR TELI) 
  
(a):  Cereals, fruits, vegetables, dairy, meat, poultry, marine & spices are some of the major 
agricultural products which are processed in the country. In addition, ready to eat (RTE) & 
ready to cook (RTC) products also fall within the category of processed food products. 
  
(b):  The share of India’s export of food products in world’s export of food products was 2.27 
per cent in 2019 as per the latest international data. In order to boost India’s share in global food 
exports, the Government is implementing  a comprehensive Agricult ure Export Policy.  
Financial Assistance Schemes of the Agriculture & Processed Food Products Export 
Development Authority, Marine Products Export Development Authority Schemes, are being 
implemented to boost agricultural and marine products exports. A new  Production Linked 
Incentive (PLI) scheme for food processing sector with the objectives of making Indian 
manufacturers globally competitive, attracting investment,  boosting exports and creating 
global ‘champions’ will be implemented from 2021-22.  
  
(c) & (d): The food processing sector is dominated by unorganized sector with 24.59 lakh 
unincorporated food processing units. In addition, there are 40,162 registered units in the food 
processing sector as per the latest estimates of the Ministry of Statistic s and Programme 
Implementation. 
  
  As part of Aatmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan, the Ministry of Food Processing Industries 
has launched a centrally sponsored Pradhan Mantri Formulization of Micro Food Processing 
Enterprises (PM -FME) scheme which provides fina ncial, technical and capacity building 
support for upgradation and formalization of 2 lakh micro food processing enterprises. For 
increasing the efficiency in the food processing sector, the Ministry has been extending 
346

financial assistance to Research Projects for the benefit of food processing industry in terms of 
product and process development, efficient technologies, improved packaging, value addition 
etc. through the Research & Development scheme component of the central sector scheme - 
Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana (PMKSY). 
  
The government has  also taken several reform measures to improve the efficiency of 
the sector as under: 
 
(i) A Special Food Processing Fund of Rs. 2000 crore was set up with NABARD in  
November 2014 to provide affordable credit for investments in setting up Mega Food 
Parks(MFP) as well as processing units in the MFPs and Agro-processing clusters (APCs). 
 
(ii) Classification of food & agro -based processing units and cold chain as 
agriculturalactivity for Priority Sector Lending (PSL) n orms was done as per the revised RBI 
Guidelines issued on 23.4.2015. 
 
(iii) 100% FDI under automatic route for manufacturing food products has beenpermitted. 
 
(iv) 100% FDI was permitted under government approved route for retail trading,including 
through e-commerce, in respect of food products manufactured/ produced in India. 
 
(v) For ease of doing food business, FSSAI (Food Safety & Standards Authority ofIndia) 
has notified the ingredients & additive based approval in place of the productwise approval.

STEPS TAKEN TO ENSURE PANCHAYAT ELECTIONS AT REGULAR INTERVALS 
 
2032. SHRI BIKASH RANJAN: 
           
Will the Minister of PANCHAYATI RAJ be pleased to state: 
  
the steps that have been taken by the Central Government for taking the State  
Governments into confidence to conduct regular Panchayat elections at regular intervals 
to uphold the provisions of the Constitution? 
 
ANSWER 
  
THE MINISTER OF PANCHAYATI RAJ 
(SHRI NARENDRA SINGH TOMAR) 
 
Article 243E (3) of the Constitution of India provides that an election to constitute a 
Panchayat shall be completed before the expiry of its duration of five years or before the 
expiration of a period  of six months from the date of its dissolution. Further, ‘Panchayat’ is a 
State subject and part of Seventh Schedule of the Constitution, t herefore, timely conduct  of 
Panchayat elections comes under the purview of respective State Government. Article 243K of 
the Constitution vests the superintendence, direction and control of the preparation of electoral 
rolls for, and the conduct of, all elections to the Panchayats , in a State Election Commission 
consisting of a State Election Commissioner to be appointed by the Governor. 
 
Further, the Central Government also monitors the regular conduct of Panchayat elections 
and advises the respective State Governments in this regard through meetings and advisories 
from time to time.

2034 Shri Rakesh Sinha: 
 
Will the Minister of PANCHAYATI RAJ be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Government would contemplate to add the provision in the Act to have 
Planning Board for every Panchayat by involving some technocrats and local elected 
representatives and non -elected officials to make perspective plans for villages, as 
Panchayats are vital organs of  our democratic process and development and a 
significant part of funds are allotted to them; 
(b)  whether Government would organise a study to explore the need for such Boards as

planning by Panchayats?

(SHRI NARENDRA SINGH TOMAR) 
 
(a)    to (c) No Sir. Article 243G of the Constitution provides that the Legislature of a State 
may, by law, endow the Panchayats to be effective instruments of self -government and may 
provide for the devolution of powers and responsibilities upon Panchayats at the appropriate 
level, subject to specified conditions, with respect to the preparation of plans for economic 
development and social justice  and the implementation of schemes for economic 
development and social justice as may be entrusted to them including those in relation to 
matters listed in the Eleventh Schedule. 
  
In terms of above constitutional mandate, Gram Panchayats have been prepari ng Gram 
Panchayat Development Plan (GPDP)  as per respective State GPDP guidelines, which also 
provides for formation of Gram Panchayat  Planning Facilitation Team (GPPFT) having 
representation from well meaning/ philanthropic/ voluntary human resources and sectoral/

(a) the details of freight loss Railways incurred during the recent lockdown;

(c) how Ministry looks at these losses and the likely operating ratio this year; 
(d) whether Ministry found some improvement in passenger and freight earnings after opening up 
of  lockdown and, if so, the details thereof; 
(e) how Ministry is planning to recover the losses incurred during lockdown period; and 
(f) the proposals before the Ministry to monetize some of the assets of Railways to recover from

ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMERCE & INDUSTRY AND

(SHRI PIYUSH GOYAL) 
 
(a) & (b): Overall profit or loss of Indian Railways is calculated at the close of a Financial Year. 
However, due to the adverse impact of COVID 19 pandemic, consequential lockdown and partial 
operation of passenger services, total traffic revenue of Railways i n the current year to end of 
January 2021 has declined by ` 36,918.86 crore compared to corresponding period of last year, 
comprising a decline of ` 34,750.51 crore in Passenger revenue. Freight revenue has however 
increased by ` 557.17 crore to end of January compared to corresponding period of last year. 
 
(c): Railways have tried their best to effect  maximum savings in controllable operating expenses to 
offset a part of decline in revenue. Decline in railway receipts generally have an adverse impact on 
Operating Ratio which is calculated at the close of the Financial year

(d): Railways have witnessed significant improvement in freight and passenger revenue in the post 
lockdown phase.  Passenger revenue  which had witnessed a decline of 107.7% to end of May 2020 
over corresponding period of last year,  has now improved to a d ecline of 78.5% to the end of 
January 2021 over  corresponding period of last year .  Freight revenue  which had witnessed a 
decline of 32.7% to end of May 2020 over corresponding period of last year, has now improved to 
an increase of 0.6% to end of January 2021 over. Despite the improvement in revenue position, 
Railways have anticipated a resource gap in 2020 -21 and the Government has extended a special 
loan to Railways for the Covid related resource gap to incur inevitable expenditure. 
 
(e):  (i) After the easing of lockdown by Ministry of Home Affairs, Railways took a number of 
steps to move more freight traffic and the shortfall of freight traffic of 70 million tonnes during the 
period April’2020 has been considerably made good upto July’ 2020 as compared  to the 
corresponding period of last year.  Indian Railways have loaded 1102.58 million tonnes from April, 
2020 to February, 2021 as against 1107.20 million tonnes during the corresponding period of last 
financial year.  
 (ii)  In addition to this following steps have been taken to recover the losses in passenger segment:  
 20 Pairs of Clone trains were started from 21 September 2020 as clones of highly patronized 
trains with unmet demands in terms of waitlist.  Presently 32 such trains are being operated.  
 Close watch over heavily waitlisted trains and running festival/ holiday special trains on 
special fares to meet demand.  
 Unreserved coaches are being operated as 2S reserved class (including reservation charges) 
to avoid overcrowding.  
 Augmentation of on-board capacity by attachment of additional coaches. 
 Organizing intensive ticket checking drives, including fortress checks, etc to discourage

during journeys. To the extent feasible, face masks are made available for sale through 
multipurpose stalls and mask dispensing 
machines.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (e) OF UNSTARRED QUESTION     
NO. 2050 BY SHRI RAKESH SINHA  ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 12.03.2021 
REGARDING REVENUE FROM MONETIZATION OF LAND AND OTHER PROPERTIES 
(a)  and (b):  As on 31.03.2020, t he total land in possession of Indian Railways is about 4.81 lakh 
hectares and out of which approximately 814.55 hectare land (0.17%) is under encroachment.  
(c): Yes, Sir. The vacant land, which is not required by Railways for its immediate operational 
needs, is utilized in the interim period for commercial development through Rail Land Development 
Authority (RLDA) setup by an amendment to the Railways Act, 1989 (Act No. 47 of 2005) , 
wherever feasible, in order to mobilize additional financial resources.

encroachment and take action for their removal. If the encroachments are of temporary nature (soft 
encroachments) in the shape of jhuggies, jhopris and squatters, the same are removed in consultation 
with and the assistance of Railway Protection Force and local civil authorities.  For old 
encroachments, where party is not amenable to persuasion, action is taken under Public Premises 
(Eviction of Unauthorized Occupants) Act, 1971 (PPE Act, 1971), as amended from time to time.  
Actual eviction of unauthorized occupants is carried out with the assistance of State Government and 
police.  Railways are actively involved in removal of encroachment from Railways land. Due to 
consistent efforts of Railways, during the last three years from April 2017 to March 2020, a total of 
47.15 Hectare of Railways land, has been retrieved from encroachment. 
(e): The revenue earned from monetization of land during 2017-18, 2018-19 and 2019-20 by 
RLDA is `
43 Cr., `83 Cr. and `933 Cr. respectively.

2061  SHRI VAIKO: 
               
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Railways have resumed all the express and passenger trains, as per the railway 
time table issued; 
 
(b) if not, the percentage of trains being operated in the country, especially the trains 
traversing through Tamil Nadu; and

2062  SHRI T.G. VENKATESH: 
 
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether the attention of Government is drawn to the proposal of setting up of more 
rural development projects across the country, by earmarking ₹25 lakh crores for 
implementation of these project in the present Five Year Plan; 
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and 
(c)  the number of such projects being implemented in the state of Andhra Pradesh and 
the quantum of funds earmarked for each project, the status thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRI NARENDRA SINGH TOMAR) 
 
 
(a)&(b):  The Ministry of Rural Development is implementing a number of schemes/programmes 
to 
bring about overall improvement in the quality of life of the people in rural areas including the 
State of Andhra Pradesh through employment generation, strengthening of livelihood 
opportunities, promoting self-employment, skilling of rural youths, provision of social assistance 
and other basic amenities. The revised estimate of the Ministry of Rural Development for the 
year 2020-21 is Rs. 193918.69 crore. The details of the schemes/programmes implemented by 
the Ministry of Rural Development are given below:- 
  
(i) Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS): 
  
The principal objective of the scheme is to provide for the enhancement of livelihood security 
of 
the households by providing at least one hundred days of guaranteed wage employment in 
every financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled 
manual work. It stresses on creation of durable and sustainable assets to make the beneficiaries 
self-dependant. MGNREGS is a demand driven scheme with bottom-up approa
 ch.  As on 
10.03
.2021, a total of 360.96 Cr. person days have been generated with a budget outlay of Rs. 
111,500 Cr. for the financial year 2020-21. 
  
(ii) Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-
NRL
M): The Ministry is implementing DAY-NRLM, to tackle the problem of unemployment, 
especially among women, in a mission mode with the objective of organizing the rural poor 
women into Self Help Groups (SHGs), and continuously nurturing and supporting them to take 
economic activities till they attain appreciable increase in income over a period of time to 
improve their quality of life and come out of abject poverty. Besides, Start-up Village 
399

Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP), the sub-scheme under DAY-NRLM, has the objective 
of helping Self Help Group (SHG) and their family members to set-up small enterprises in the 
non-farm sector. As on date, 7.35 crore women have been mobilized into 76 lakh SHGs. Under 
DAY-NRLM, the budget outlay for financial year 2020-21 is Rs.9210.05 crore which includes 
the budget outlay of Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen KaushalyaYojana (DDU-GKY) and 
Rural Self Employment and Training Institutes (RSETIs). 
  
(iii) Deen  Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen KaushalyaYojana (DDU-GKY) and Rural Self 
Employment and Training Institutes (RSETIs): 
 
The Ministry of Rural Development is implementing two skill development initiatives 
for rural poor youth under the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM). These schemes 
are aimed at increasing employability of rural poor youth either for wage or self employment 
leading to economic and social development of youth of rural area of the country by removing 
the hurdles of the rural livelihoods and by strengthening rural economy and rural income. 
 
 Dee
n Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) is the placement 
linked skill development programme for rural poor youth under NRLM being in operation 
since September, 2014 . As on 31.01.2021, a total of 15094 candidates have been trained and 
38359 candidates have been placed. 
             
Skill development through Rural Self Employment and Training Institutes (RSETIs) is 
also being undertaken to enable a trainee to take bank credit and start his/her own Micro-
enterprise. Some of such trainees may also seek regular salaried jobs. As on 31.01.2021, a total 
of 152509 candidates have been trained and 108931 candidates have been settled. 
 
  
(iv) Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G): PMA Y-G aims to provide a pucca 
house with basic amenities to all rural houseless households and households living in kutcha 
and dilapidated houses in rural areas. With the objective of ‘Housing for all’, The target under 
PMAY-G is to construct 2.95 crore houses during the period 2016-17 to 2021-22. As on 
10.03
.2021, a total of 1.32 crore houses have been constructed. The budget outlay for the 
financial year 2020-21 is Rs. 19500.01 crore. 
 
(v) Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY):  PMGSY was started in the year 2000 
with the objective to provide all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected habitations. 
The mandate of the scheme was subsequently widened and new interventions viz. PMGSY-II 
and PMGSY-III were added for upgradation of the existing rural road network which connect 
habitations to the various facilities and services. The implementation of the ongoing PMGSY 
has helped immensely in lifting the socio–economic conditions of rural masses by providing 
them access to the various services and facilities, market place and employment opportunities 
in various forms. As on 03.03.2021, a total of 25,476 Kms. road has been constructed against 
the target of 46,164 Kms. with the financial outlay of Rs.19500 crore in financial year 2020-21. 
 
 
(vi) Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Rurban Mission (SPMRM):   The Shyama Prasad Mukherji 
Rurban Mission (SPMRM) launched in February 2016, is a scheme with the objective to 
stimulate local economic development, enhance basic services, and create well planned Rurban 
clusters. The mission takes cluster as a unit for development. 300 Clusters from all the States/ 
UTs are selected in the first phase of the Mission in Tribal and Non-Tribal categories. SPMRM 
provides the Critical Gap Funding to the projects which directly or indirectly bring economic 
growth. SPMRM aims to provide amenities in four categories viz Basic, Economic, Social and 
Digital and promotes economic growth through integrated and balanced investments with 
400

social inclusion. A total investment of Rs. 27,605 crore (including Rs. 20,817 cr. Convergence 
and Rs. 6,787 cr. CGF) is approved in these clusters out of which expenditure worth Rs. 11,544 
cr. (41%) is already done as on 08.03.2021. 
(vii) Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY):   Saa nsad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY) was 
launched on 11 October 2014. Under the SAGY framework, the development of Gram 
Panchayats is envisaged through effective convergence and implementation of existing 
development Schemes of Government under the administrative control of respective Ministries 
without allocation of any additional fund.

Central Sponsored Public – Private Partnership Project, Farmer, Farmer Producers

ii. National Programme for Dairy Development (NPDD), under the Department of Animal

(a)  whether Government of Karnataka has requested the Central Government for 
release of the pending funds under MGNREGA to the State during 2020-21; 
(b)  the details of the funds released so far and the quantum of pending funds to be 
released; and 
(c)  the reasons for delay in releasing funds to Karnataka under MGNREGA for 2020-
21? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRI NARENDRA SINGH TOMAR) 
 
 
 
(a) The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (Mahatma Gandhi 
NREGS
) is a demand driven wage employment guarantee programme. Under Mahatma Gandhi 
NREGS, States/UTs (including Karnataka) submit funds release proposals to Government of 
India. Fund release to the States/UTs is a continuous process and Central Government is 
committed to making funds available to States/UTs for the implementation of Mahatma Gandhi 
NREGS. The Ministry release funds periodically in two tranches with each tranche consisting of 
one or more installments, keeping in view the “agreed to” Labour Budget, demand for works, 
opening balance, pace of utilization of funds, pending liabilities and overall performance. 
 
(b) & (c)  During the current financial year 2020-21 (as on 09.03.2021), the Ministry has 
released Rs.5218.34 crore (including Rs. 3968.79 crore as wage component & Rs. 1249.55 crore 
as material and administrative component) to the State of Karnataka under Mahatma Gandhi 
NREGS.  There is no pending wage liability as on 09.03.2021 under Mahatma Gandhi NREGS. 
The release of fund to States/UTs is a continuous process and Central Government is committed 
to making funds available to States/UTs for implementation of Mahatma Gandhi NREGS as per 
procedure.

In the year 2013, PMGSY-II was launched for upgradation of selected Through Routes and 
Major Rural Links (MRLs) with a target to upgrade 50,000 Km in various States and Union 
Territories.  
Subsequently, in 2016, Road Connectivity Project for Left Wing Extremism Affected Areas 
(RCPLWEA) was launched as a separate vertical under PMGSY for construction/upgradation of 
strategically important roads. Aim of the scheme is to improve the road connectivity in 44 worst 
affected LWE districts and some adjoining districts in  9 States, viz. Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, 
Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Odisha, Telangana and Uttar Pradesh. 
The scheme has twin objectives of enabling smooth and seamless anti-LWE operations by the 
security forces and also ensuring socio-economic development of the area. 
In the year 2019, Government launched PMGSY-III for consolidation of 1,25,000 Km Through 
Routes and Major Rural Links connecting habitations,  inter-alia, to Gramin Agricultural 
Markets (GrAMs), Higher Secondary Schools and Hospitals.

CHANGE IN CRITERIA UNDER DAY-NRLM 
 
2065  SMT. AMBIKA SONI: 
 
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government has made certain changes in the criterion to extend benefits 
under the Deendayal Antyodaya- National Rural Livelihood Mission (DAY-
NRLM); 
(b)  if so, the details thereof; 
(c)  the number of beneficiaries who benefitted from DAY-NRLM during the last three 
years– State-wise including Punjab; and 
(d)  the steps taken by Government to provide livelihood to women in rural areas across 
the country? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRI NARENDRA SINGH TOMAR) 
 
 
 
(a) & (b) Yes Sir. Under Deendayal Antyodaya- National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-
NRLM) earlier the households included in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list were considered 
the target group. Subsequently, from 2014-15 onwards, the criteria has been changed. All 
households with at least one deprivation, as per the Socio Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 
2011 database, are included in the DAY-NRLM target group. In addition, all households 
identified though the process of Participatory Identification of Poor (PIP) and vetted by the Gram 
Sabha can also be covered under the Programme.  
 
(c)&(d): The Ministry of Rural Development is implementing Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – 
National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) across the country in a mission mode with 
the objective of organizing the rural poor women into Self Help Groups (SHGs), and 
continuously nurturing and supporting them to take up economic activities till they attain 
appreciable increase in income over a period of time to improve their quality of life and come 
out of abject poverty.  
 
DAY-NRLM also has a sub-scheme namely Start-up Village Entrepreneurship 
Programme (SVEP) to promote entrepreneurship at village level. The block is the unit of 
implementation of SVEP. The objective of the scheme is to help the rural poor (SHGs) to set-
up enterprises at the village level in non-agricultural sectors. Besides providing start-up 
capital, a cadre of Community Resource Persons-Enterprise Promotion (CRP-EP) is set up to 
410

provide business support services to enterprises. SHG members are supported under the 
project. 
Under Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP), which is another sub-scheme of 
DAY-NRLM aims at meeting the specific needs of women farmers to enable them to achieve 
socio-economic empowerment. The primary objective of the MKSP is to empower women in 
agriculture by making systematic investments to enhance their participation and productivity, as 
also create and sustain their agriculture-based livelihoods. The scheme also supports 
development of a pool of community resource persons to enable the community institutions to 
manage their activities. 
   During the last three years i.e 2018-2021 (up to January, 2021) 14,57,213 Self Help 
Groups (SHGs) have been promoted and 2,63,52,365 Households have been mobilized under 
DAY-NRLM. In order to reduce the effective cost of bank credit to women SHGs, DAY-NRLM 
provides Interest Subvention and additional Interest Subvention to SHGs from Financial Year 
2013-14. All women SHGs whose members are from the DAY-NRLM target group, are eligible 
for receiving Interest Subvention equal to the difference between the borrowing rate of interest 
and 7%. The funding for this subvention is being provided to the State Rural Livelihoods 
Missions (SRLMs) by this Ministry. In addition, in respect of 250 backward districts, all women 
SHGs can avail loans up to Rs.3.00 Lakh each at 7% rate of interest per annum, with an 
additional interest subvention of 3% on prompt repayment, reducing the effective interest rate to 
4%. In the last three years 1.02 Crore SHGs have been disbursed 1,913.84 Lakh Crore loan. 
Further, under Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP), which is a sub-scheme 
under DAY-NRLM, 1,13,159 enterprises have been formed during the last three years. Under 
Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP), which is another sub-scheme of DAY-NRLM, 
more than 38 lakh Mahila Kisans have been supported. The State-wise details of the 
beneficiaries under NRLM during the last three years including Punjab are provided at 
Annexure-I.

INTERNATIONAL DAY OF RURAL WOMEN 
 
2068  SHRI SANJAY SETH: 
SHRI RAJEEV SATAV: 
 
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government observed International Day of Rural Women recently and if 
so, the details thereof along with the theme of the event and initiatives taken by 
Government to make the event successful; 
(b)  the details of the schemes for women belonging to SC/ST/OBC and economically 
weaker sections in rural areas and the employment generated thereunder,  State/UT-
wise; 
(c)  the details of funds allocated, released and utilised by the States under the scheme, 
State/UT-wise; and 
(d)  whether Government has failed to generate employment opportunities for women in 
rural areas and if so, the details thereof? 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRI NARENDRA SINGH TOMAR) 
(a) As informed by Department of Agriculture, Cooperation  & Farmers’ Welfare 
(DAC&FW), the Department is celebrating Mahila Kisan Diwas on 15 th October, International 
Day
 of Rural Women every year, since 2018 onwards. 
 
 
(b) Most of the schemes/ programmes of Government of India have separate provisions for 
women and other vulnerable sections of the society.  Multi-pronged strategies are being taken by 
the Ministry of Rural Development to improve the economic well-being of the people in rural 
areas including that of women belonging to SC/ST/OBC and Economically Weaker Section with 
the main focus on increasing livelihood opportunities, empowering rural women, providing 
social safety net, skilling of rural youth, infrastructure development etc, through its programmes 
viz. Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS), Deendayal 
Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM), Deen Dayal Upadhyay 
– Gramin Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY),  Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-
G), Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY), Shyama Prasad Mukherjee National 
RuRBAN Mission and National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP).  
 
419

 
Out of these schemes/programmes, the following Schemes of the Ministry generate 
employment/enhance the employability including of women in rural areas, the details of which 
are given below: 
(i) The Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-
NRLM), is a centrally sponsored anti-poverty programme launched in June 2011. The 
Mission seeks to reach out to all rural poor households in a phased manner and impact 
their livelihoods significantly. DAY-NRLM has been designed to be implemented in a 
Mission mode, with both the Govt. of India and the states sharing the cost. The Mission 
has covered 6360 blocks spread over 691 districts across 28 States and 6 UTs up to 
January, 2021. This is a totally women oriented programme, as of date 7.35 crore women 
have been mobilized in 67 lakhs Self Help Groups (SHGs). 
 
(ii) Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP ) 
 is a sub-scheme of DAY-
NRLM with the objective to help the rural poor to set-up enterprises at the village level in 
non-agricultural sectors. Besides providing start-up capital, a cadre of Community 
Resource Persons-Enterprise Promotion (CRP-EP) is set up to provide business support 
services to enterprises. SHG members are supported under the project. SVEP does not 
have a state wise allocation of funds. Supplementary Annual Action Plans are submitted 
by States/UTs. Once approved, funds are released in three instalments of 25%, 50% and 
25% respectively for implementation. So far, 1.35 lakh enterprises have been sanctioned 
of which 72%  are owned and managed by women, rest 28% are run by fam
 ily members 
of SHGs. 
 
(iii) The Ministry is implementing two Skill development initiatives for rural poor youth 
un
der National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM) to improve the economic condition of 
the rural population, namely, i. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushal Yojana 
(DDU-GKY), a placement linked skill development scheme for rural poor and ii. Skill 
development through Rural Self Employment and Training Institutes (RSETI), 
which provides skilling, thereby enabling the trainee to take bank credit and start his/her 
own Micro-enterprise. Some of such trainees may also seek regular salaried jobs. Both 
the above mentioned schemes are applicable to all the categories including women. 
Under DDU-GKY, there is a mandatory coverage of 33% women. During the current FY 
2020-21, out of the total trained, 51.03% are women and out of the total placed, 47.15% 
are women. Under RSETI, any unemployed youth in the age group of 18-45 years, 
irrespective of caste, creed, religion, gender and economic status, having aptitude to take 
up self-employment or wage employment and having some basic knowledge in the 
related field can undergo training. During the current FY 2020-21, out of the total trained, 
64.28% are women and out of the total settled, 63.71% are women. 
 
(iv) Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (Mahatma 
Gan
dhi NREGS) is a demand driven wage employment programme which provide for 
the enhancement of livelihood security of the households including women belonging to 
SC/ST/OBC and economically weaker in rural areas of the country by providing at least 
one hundred days of guaranteed wage employment in every financial year to every 
household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work. Being a demand 
driven programme, no State/UT-wise financial allocation is made.  The rate of 
participation of women in Mahatma Gandhi NREGS during the current FY 2020-21 is 
above the statutory requirement of 1/3rd women participation ie.52.96% (As on 
04.03.2021). 
420

 
(v) Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana- Gramin (PMAY-G)  has been implemented with 
effect from 1st April, 2016 to provide assistance to eligible rural households for 
construction of 2.95 Crore Pucca houses with basic amenities to achieve the objective of 
“Housing for All” by 2022. As per the provisions under Framework for Implementation 
for PMAY-G, house shall be made jointly in the name of husband and wife except in the 
case of widow, unmarried or separated person. Special provision has been made in FFI 
for allowing sanction in the name of female members of household or jointly in the name 
of husband & wide, except in some circumstance. Of the total houses allocated, 67% 
houses are owned either by women or in joint name. 
Rural Mason Training is one of the components of PMAY-G. Under RMT, States/UTs as 
per the assigned targets, are responsible to plan and conduct training of masons in 
locations where the construction intensity is projected to be high. Ministry of Rural 
Development has also developed curriculum for Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) 
pertaining to rural masons wherein persons already having knowledge in rural masonry 
would be provided a bridge training and after assessment, the certification. The States / 
UTs may identify such persons, train and certify them. As on 24.02.2021, a total of 7702 
female masons have been certified under the scheme.

MINISTER OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT

(a):  The Hon’ble Members of Parliament have adopted 2,046 Gram Panchayats under

ansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY) till 8 March, 2021. The Statewise details of Gram

in the Guidelines that the critical gaps in the development plan for the Gram Panchayat may be

opment and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) is implementing central component of Pradhan Mantri

used f
or training of PwD.

stak
eholder consultations of all job roles in order to obtain their inputs on the PwD amenability of

ls and Training Partners as a part of overall “Placement incentives & Job Melas / Rozgar Utsav”

2079  L
t.Gen. (Dr.) D. P. Vats (Retd.): 
Dr. Amee Yajnik: 
 
Will the Minister of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship be p leased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government has any plan to provide the agriculture related training to create 
interest among the youth in agricultural sector keeping in view the immense employment potential 
in the said sector and if so, the details thereof; 
 
(b) whether training is being provided to the youth for getting employment in horticulture, bee-
keeping and
 animal husbandry; 
 
(c) if so, the details thereof, and 
 
(d) the other measures taken/proposed to be taken by Government for skill development in the 
agric
ulture sector? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF  
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) to (d): The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) had signed a 
Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare on 20 th 
Marc
h 2018 with a view to creating an efficient and effective training, assessment and certification 
process for skill development in varied job roles in agriculture, horticulture, animal husbandry, 
fisheries, etc. The MoU also seeks to encourage employment of skilled and certified workforce and 
Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) of the workforce already engaged in the sector, besides 
encouraging youth to undergo skill training in various vocations in agriculture for livelihood 
opportunities. The Agriculture Skill Council of India (ASCI) has developed 173 Qualification Packs 
for various job roles for Agriculture. The skill training courses are conducted through National 
Training Institutes, State Level Training Institutes, Krishi Vigyan Kendras and State Agricultural 
Universities. The major areas of skill trainings include mushroom production, beekeeping, micro-
irrigation, maintenance and repair of farm equipment, horticulture, organic grower, vermi-compost 
production, animal husbandry, dairying, poultry, fishery, etc.  
 
The Government, through the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY), Jan Shikshan 
Sansthan and other programmes like Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana and State Skill Missions has 
been imparting skill training in horticulture, bee-keeping and animal husbandry. As per data 
provided by ASCI, the number of persons trained in these sectors is given below:  
 
Horticulture:  38,371  
Bee-keeping:  4,044; 
Animal Husbandry (Dairy and Poultry): 48,525. 
 
The Government has been facilitating RPL, which has helped in providing vocational identity to the 
agriculture farmers and labourers. RPL, with bridge training, has enabled up-skilling/ re-skilling of 
farmers and has also provided other benefits viz. access to credit, access to market, reduction in 
losses, provision of digital skills through apps for accessing advisory and market information, 
financial literacy for enabling them to calculate and price their produce, and benefit through safe 
and judicious use of agro-chemicals.

2080    SHRI KAMAKHYA PRASAD TASA: 
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be pleased to 
state:
 
 
(a)  the progress of PM’s National Council on Skill Development which aims to  skill 500 
mil
lion people in India by 2022; 
 
(b)  the list of number of people skilled in the financial year 2020-21, State- wise; 
 
(c)  whether any skilling initiatives are being contemplated or implemented  specifically for 
tribal
s, in particular the tribals of Assam who constitute  12.4% of the State's population; and 
 
(d)  if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
 
ANS
WER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) to (d): The target of skilling 500 million people in India by 2022 was set under the National Skill 
Development Policy 2009. Subsequently, the National Policy on Skill Development and 
Entrepreneurship 2015 came into force with effect from 1 st July 2015. Under the 2015 Policy, the 
target
 for skilling from 2015-2022 was set at 402.87 million, comprising 104.62 million new entrants 
to the workforce who need to be skilled to meet industry requirements, and 298.25 million existing 
workforce who need Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), re-skilling, up-skilling and skilling.  
 
The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) is implementing schemes viz. 
Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY), Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS) Scheme and 
National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) for skill development of all sections of the 
society, including tribals. The State/ Union Territory (UT) - wise details of people who have 
benefitted under PMKVY, JSS and NAPS in the financial year 2020-21 are given in Annexure I, 
Annexure II and Annexure III respectively.  
 
Under PMKVY, 45,233 Scheduled Tribes (ST) candidates have been trained/ oriented in the State 
of Assam from 2016-17 to 2020-21 (as on 19.01.2021). Under JSS scheme, 862 ST candidates 
have been trained in the State of Assam from 2018-19 to 2020-21. Under NAPS, 2,607 youths have 
been trained in the State of Assam in 2020-21 (up to 28.02.2021), including 7% from the ST 
category. In addition, under the fee-based market-led model of the National Skill Development 
Corporation, 5,081 tribal candidates have been trained in the State of Assam in 2019-20 and 2020-
21.

श्री सैयद जफर इस लाम द्िारा पूछे जाने िाले तारांककत प्रश् न सं .183 के भाग (क) से (घ) के  
उत् तर से संबंिधत वववरि।  
 
(क ) और (ख): जी िां। रेल मंत्रालय द्िारा ईएमय ू और पैसेंजर गाड़ियों सहित सभी रेलगाड़ियों 
के सिारी डिब् बों में क् लोज् ़्ीि सककटट टेलीवि़नन (सीसीटीिी) कैमरे लगाने के ललए उपाय ककए गए 
िैं। 
 
2931 सिारी डिब् बों में सीसीटीिी कैमरे पिले िी लगा हदए गए िैं और भारतीय रेल द्िारा 
यात्रत्रयों की संरक्षा और सुरक्षा बढाने के उद्देश् य से न् य सिारी डिब् बों में मिकलमक रूप से

पररलशष् ट में हदया गया िै।  
 
(ग) और (घ): रेलों पर प ुललस की व् यिस था करना राज्य सरकार का विषय िै , इसललए रेल 
परर सरों और चलती गाड़ियों में नपराधों की रोकथाम करना , मामलों का पंजीकरण करना , उनकी 
जांच करना और कान ून व् यिस था बनाए रखना , राज् य सरकारों का सां वििधक उत् तरदानयत् ि िै ,

1962. श्रीमती वप्रयंका र्तुव ेिी: 
 ले. जनरल (डा.) डी.पी. वत्स (ररटा.) : 
  
 क्या रसायन और उवव रक  मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे कक : 
 
(क)  सरकार द्वारा हाल ही में ककतनी जीवन -रक्षक दवाओं की कीमतों में कमी की गई हैं ;  
(ख) प्रततशत के संदर्भ में इनकी कीमतों में कमी का ब्यौरा क्या है ; 
(ग) क्या सरकार तनकट र्ववष्य में और अधिक जीवन -रक्षक दवाओं की कीमतों को घटाने का 
प्रस्ताव करती है; 
(घ) यदद हां, तो  तत्संबंिी ब्यौरा क्या है और यदद नहीं, तो इसके क्या कारण हैं ; और 
(ङ) देश में जेनेररक दवाओं की उपलब्िता की वतभमान स्स्ितत क्या है?   
 
उत्तर  
रसायन एवं उववरक मंत्री (श्री डी. वी. सिानंि गौडा) 
 
(क)  और (ख) : स्वास््य ववं पररवार क्याण मंत्रालय द्वारा राष्ट्रीीय वव्यक दवा स चीी (वनवलईवम )

न् यानयक  जेंनसयों , नजन् हें सामान् यतया ‘उपभोक् ता ोयोग ’ क े  िाम से जािा जाता हक, नजसे नजला स् तर पर (नजला

‍ र्ररत न् याय-निणवयि क े  नल  कािूि द्वारा िन िेा निया गया हक।

न् याय रत्नाया को सरल बिािे हेतु क  उपाय करिे क े  नल  जकसे नक इलेक् रॉनिक माध् यम से नाकायत िजव करािा

विषय: फुट एंड माउथ डडजीज ‘कंट्रोल प्रोग्राम’ 
2016. श्रीमती फूलो देिी नेतम:  
 
क्या मत्स्यपालन, पश ुपालन और डेयरी मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करेंगे कक:  
(क ) फुट एंड माउथ डडजीज ‘कंट्रोल प्रोग्राम’ के कियान्ियन हेत ु कक न -ककन राज्यों ने ककतनी -ककतनी राशश 
के वि्त ृत कायययोजना प्र्ताि क ें द्र सरकार को भेजे हैं, गत दो िषों का तत्ससंबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है; 
और  
(ख) उक्त प्र्तािों के संदभय में क ें द्र सरकार ने राज्यों को ककतनी धनराशश सं्िीक ृत की है , और राज्यों 
को ककतनी राशश देना शेष है ? 
 
उत्तर 
मत्स्यपालन,पशुपालन और डेयरी राज्य मंत्री 
(डॉ. संजीि कुमार बाललयान ) 
 
(क) और (ख) विभाग ने  िषय 2019-20 तक खुरपका और म ु
ंहपका रोग -ननयंत्रण काययिम (एफएमडी-सीपी) 
को राज् यों/संघ राज् य क्षेत्रों में पशुधन ् िा् ् य और रोग ननयंत्रण (एलएचऔरडीसी) योजना के तहत एक 
घटक के रूप लाग ू ककया था। िषय 2019-20 में ,एफएमडी और ब्रूसेलोशसस के ननयंत्रण के शलए एलएच 
और डीसी योजना  के एफएमडी -सीपी और ब्रूसेलोशसस -सीपी घटकों के साथ एक क ें द्रीय सेक् टर योजना , 
राष्‍ट ट्रीय पश ु रोग ननयंत्रण काययिम (एनएडीसीपी) बनाई गई  थी। एफएमडीसीपी के  शलए विगत दो िषों 
अथायत् 2018-19 और 2019 -20 के तहत और उसके साथ-साथ िषय 2019-20 में एनएडीसीपी के तहत 
राज् यों/संघ राज् य क्षेत्रों के शलए प्र् तावित और जारी ननधधयों का वििरण अन ुबंध में ददया गया है।  
 
राज् यों/संघ राज् य क्षेत्रों को जारी करने के शलए कोई ननधधयां लंबबत नहीं हैं क् यों कक सं् िीक ृत ननधध यों  का 
मूल यांकन , राज् यों/संघ राज् य क्षेत्रों की आिश् यकता , उपलब् ध बजट और प ूिय में जारी राशश में से राज् यों/संघ 
राज् य क्षेत्रों के पास उपलब् ध अव् यनयत शेष राशश के आधार पर ककया गया था।

(घ)  यह लकस हद तक देश क े  खाद्य प्रसंस् करण क्षेत्र क े  लल ए लाभदायक होगा; और  
(ङ)  क्या सरकार को भारत में फ ू ड पार्क्च की स्थापना करने क े  लल ए लवदेशों से कोई प्रस्ताव प्राप्त हुए 
हैं, तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है?  
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेिी) 
 
(ि) से (घ): र्यलनत राज्ों में सूक्ष्म और लघु खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यमों (एमएसई) की प्रलतस्पधी क्षमताओं 
को प्रोत् साहन देने पर ध्यान क ें लरत करते हुए एक पररयोजना लडजाइन लवकलसत करने क े  ललए वर्च 2018 
और 2019 क े  दौरान लवश्व बैंक क े  साथ बातर्ीत हुई थी। तथालप, आंतररक संसाधनों क े  साथ आगे बढ़ने 
का लनणचय ललया गया था और तदनुसार इस प्रस्ताव को बाद में उलर्त परामशच क े  बाद छोड़ लदया गया 
था । 
(ङ):   ऐसे कोई प्रस्ताव प्राप्त नहीं हुए हैं।

2028   डा. एल. हनुमांतय्या:  
क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:  
(ि)  क े न्द्रीय सरकार द्वारा क ु ल लकतनी मेगा फ ू ड पाक च पररयोजनाए ं अनुमोलदत की गई , तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा 
क्या है;  
(ख)  क्या वतचमान में सभी मेगा फ ू ड पाक च  पररयोजनाओं का संर्ालन शुरू कर लदया गया है;

(घ)  सरकार द्वारा यह सुलनलित करने क े  ललए क्या-क्या कदम उठाए जा रहे हैं लक मेगा फ ू ड पार्क्च का 
संर्ालन शीघ्रालतशीघ्र शुरू कर लदया जाए, तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेली) 
 
(ि) से (ग):  खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय खाद्य प्रसंस्करण क े  ललए आधुलनक अवसंरर्ना सृलजत 
करने क े  ललए मेगा फ ू ड पाक च  योजना (एमएफपी) को कायाचन्वित कर रहा है। यह योजना अब क ें द्रीय क्षेत्र की 
अम्ब्रेला योजना- प्रधानमंत्री लकसान सम्पदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) का एक घटक है।  मंत्रालय ने इस 
योजना क े  अंतगचत देश क े  37 मेगा फ ू ड पाकों और 2 मेगा फ ू ड पाकों को सैद्ांलतक को अंलतम अनुमोदन 
लदया गया है। इनमें से 22 मेगा फ ू ड पाक च  पररयोजनाएं प्रर्ालनरत है और 17 पररयोजनाए ं  कायाचियन क े  
लवलभन्न र्रणों क े  अधीन है। देश में मेगा फ ू ड पाक च  योजना क े  अंतगचत अनुमोलदत 39 मेगा फ ू ड पाक च  
पररयोजनाओं और उनक े  कायाचियन की वतचमान न्वथिलत का राज्यवार ब्यौरा संलग्नक में लदया गया है। मेगा 
फ ू ड पाक च  योजना क े  लदशा-लनदेशों क े  अनुसार मेगा फ ू ड पाक च  पररयोजनाओं को पूरा करने क े  ललए समय 
सारणी इन पररयोजना प्रस्तावों को अंलतम अनुमोदन पत्र जारी करने की तारीख से 30 माह है। मेगा फ ू ड 
पाक च  क े  प्रमोटरों को पररयोजना क े  ललए अनुमोदन प्राप्त करते समय लनधाचररत समयसीमा क े  अनुसार 
पररयोजनाओं को पूरा करने क े  ललए हर संभव प्रयास करने की आवश्यकता है। लनधाचररत समयसीमा का 
अनुपालन न करने की न्वथिलत में अप्रत्यालशत कारणों अिवा प्रमोटर क े  लनयंत्रण से बाहर कारणों क े  मामले को 
छोड़कर अंतर मंत्रालयी अनुमोदन सलमलत (आईमैक) दजच लकए जाने वाले कारणों क े  ललए पररयोजना को पूरा 
करने की समयसीमा का लवस्तार कर सकती है अिवा मामले  दर मामले क े  आधार पर अनुदान रालश को 
कम करने क े  संदभच में उलर्त जुमाचना लगाने पर लवर्ार कर सकती है। मेगा फ ू ड पाक च  पररयोजनाओं क े  
संर्ालन में देरी क े  प्रमुख कारणों में राज्य सरकार द्वारा लवलभन्न सांलवलधक मंजूरी देने में देरी, पररयोजना 
घटकों में पररवतचन-डीपीआर में संशोधन, शेयरहोन्वडंग पैटनच में बदलाव और उस पर बैंक का अनुमोदन, 
सावलध ऋण  का पु नवैधीकरण और लवतरण और पाक च  में यूलनटों को आकलषचत करने पर कम ध्यान देना 
शालमल है ।  
(घ):  मंत्रालय द्वारा यह सुलनलित करने क े  ललए कदम उठाए गए हैं लक मेगा फ ू ड पाक च  जल्द से जल्द 
प्रर्ालनरत लकए जा सक ें, लजसमें प्रमोटरों और संबंलधत राज्य सरकार क े  प्रलतलनलधयों, मंत्री, एफपीआई और 
सलर्व, एफपीआई द्वारा पररयोजनाओं क े  समयबद् समापन क े  ललए लनयलमत प्रगलत समीक्षा बैठक ें, अनुदान 
की लकस्त जारी करने को प्रािलमक प्रसंस्करण क ें द्रों (पीपीसी), स्टैंडडच लडजाइन फ ै क्टरी (एसडीएफ) शेडों 
सलहत सभी पररयोजना घटकों पर भौलतक प्रगलत क े  अनुपात में जोड़ा जाना और खाद्य प्रसंस्करण यूलनटों को 
थिालपत करने क े  ललए भूलम को पट्टे पर देना और देरी क े  ललए उलर्त जुमाचना लगाया जाना शालमल हैं। इसक े  
अलावा , पाक च  में खाद्य प्रसंस्करण यूलनटों की थिापना को  प्रोत् साहन देने क े  ललए  मंत्रालय प्रधानमंत्री लकसान 
संपदा योजना की उप-योजना क े  रूप में खाद्य प्रसंस्करण और परररक्षण क्षमताओं क े  सृजन/लवस्तार क े  ललए 
भी योजना कायाचन्व‍ वत कर रहा है ।

एफपीआई में गुणवत्ता मानि सांवर्धन 
 
2029 डा. कवनय पी. सहस्त्रबुद्धे:  
क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे  लक:  
(ि)  क्या मंत्राालय  ने गुणवत्ता मानकों का संवर्च न करने  क े  लल ए कोई कदम उठाया है, तालक प्रसंस्कृत खा द्य 
पदार्थों क े  अंतररा ष्ट्र ीय मानकों से इनकी बराबरी की जा सक े ;  
(ख)  यलद हां, तो मंत्रालय  ने खाद्य प्रसंस् करण  में गुणवत्ता मानकों का संवर्च न करने  क े  लल ए क्या-क्या कदम 
उठाये हैं; और   
(ग)  खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योगों क े  सुर्ा रू  प्रर्ालन क े  लल ए वतचमान में  लवलभन्न रा ज्ों  में उपल ब्ध शीतागार  
भंडार की क्षमता का ब्यौरा  क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेली) 
(ि) और (ख):  स्वास्थ्य एवं पररवा र कल्याण मंत्रालय क े  अंतगचत खाद्य सुरक्षा और मानक प्रालर्करण 
(एफएसएसएआई) को  खाद्य वस्तुओं क े  ललए लवज्ञान आर्ाररत मानक लनर्ाचररत करने और मानव उपभोग क े  
ललए सुरलक्षत और पौलष्ट्क भोजन की उपलब्धता सुलनलित करने क े  ललए उनक े  लवलनमाचण, भंडारण , लवतरण , 
लबक्री और आया त को लवलनयलमत करने क े  ललए अलर्लदष् ट लकया गया है । 
 
एफएसएसएआई ने वैलिक/कोडेक्स खाद्य मानकों, खाद्य लवज्ञान में नवीनतम लवकास, खाद्य खपत पैटनच , 
नए उत्पादों और योज् , प्रसंस्करण प्रौद्योलगकी और खाद्य लवश्लेषणात्मक पद्धलतयों में उन्नलत, जोखखमों की 
पहर्ान आलद  को ध्यान में रखने क े  बाद मानक लनर्ाचररत लकए  है । एफएसएसएआई ने खाद्य सुरक्षा प्रबंर्न 
प्रणाललयों क े  ललए लनयमावली ; तृतीय पक्ष ऑलडट की स्र्थापना; हैज़डच एनालललसस ए ं ड लक्रलटकल क ं ट र ोल पॉइंट्स 
(एर्एसीसीपी) और जनरल हाइ जीलनक प्रैखिसेज (जीएर्पी) क े  ललए भारतीय प्रमा णन भी लवकलसत लकए हैं ।  
 
एफएसएसएआई द्वारा अलर्सूलर्त लवलभन्न लवलनयमों क े  तहत शालमल खाद्य उत्पादों क े  मानकों में 
लववरण , संरर्ना , गुणवत्ता कारक, स्वच्छता आवश्यकताए ं, अनुमत खाद्य योजक, लवलशष्ट् लेबललंग आवश्यकताए ं  
और माइक्रोबायोलॉलजकल मानक शालमल हैं जो खाद्य उत्पा दों की सुरक्षा, गुणवत्ता और अखंडता सुलनलित करने 
क े  ललए वैज्ञालनक आर्ार प्रदान करते हैं । एफएसएसएआई ने भारी र्ातुओं और कीटनाशकों और ए ं टीबायोलटक 
दवाओं/पशु लर्लकत्सा दवाओं क े  अवशेषों की अलर्कतम सीमाए ं  भी लनर्ाचररत की हैं ।  
 
(ग):  खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) अपनी मांग  आर्ाररत  योजना "एकीक ृ त शीत 
श्ृंखला एवं मूल्य वर्चन अवसंरर्ना " क े  माध्यम से इच्छ ु क व्यखियों/उद्यलमयों/एफपीओ आलद को लवत्तीय 
सहायता प्रदान करक े  ऐसे अवसंरर्ना  की स्र्थापना का समर्थचन करता है जो योजना लदशालनदेशों की पूलतच करने 
क े  अध् यर्ीन हैं। इस योजना का उद्देश्य बागवानी और गैर -बागवानी उत्पादों क े  फसलोत् तर  क े  नुकसान को कम 
करना और लकसानों को उनकी उपज क े  ललए लाभकारी मूल्य प्रदान करना है।   
 
उि योजना क े  अंतगचत खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय द्वारा अनुमोलदत पररयोजनाओं का ब्यौरा 
सांलग् नि में लदया गया है।

झारखांड में पीएमि े एसवाई ि े  तहत आबांटन 
2030 # श्री दीपि प्रिाश:  
क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे  लक:  
(ि)  गत तीन वर्षों क े  दौरान प्रधान मंत्री लकसान संपदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) क े  तहत झारखंड 
को आबंलित/जारी की गई धनरा लि का ब्यौरा क्या है;  
(ख)  क्या जारी की गई लनलध  वांलित उद्देश्ों को प्राप्त करने  क े  लल ए पयाचप्त है; और

उत्तर 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेली) 
 
(ि) से (ग): देि भर में झारखंड राज् य सलहत प्रधान मंत्री लकसान संपदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) 
क े  अंतगचत घिक स् कीमें कायाचन्वित की जा रहीं हैं । तथालप, मंत्रालय द्वारा समय-समय पर जारी की गई 
अलभरुलर् क े  अलभव् यन्वि क े  प्रलत स् कीम क े  लदिालनदेिों क े  अनुसार झारखंड सलहत देि क े  सभी भागों 
से  पात्र पररयोजनाओं को लवत् तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है । लपिले तीन वर्षों क े  दौरान झारखंड में 
पररयोजना क े  ललए इन स् कीमों क े  अंतगचत कोई भी पात्र प्रस् ताव प्राप् त नहीं हुआ है ।

अताराांकित प्रश्न सां. 2031  
12 मार्च, 2021 को उत्तर दे ने क े  ललए 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण क्षेत्र िी द क्षता 
2031 डा. अमी याकिि:   
क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा कर ें गे लक:  
(ि)   देश में प्रसंस्कृत लकए जा रहे  कृलि और खा द्य उत्पादों का ब्यौरा क्या है;  
(ख)  क्या अंतररा ष्ट्र ीय खाद्य व्यापार में देश का लहस्सा काफी कम है  और यलद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा 
क्या है और इसमें  सुधार लाने  क े  लल ए क्या कदम उठाये गए हैं;  
(ग)  क्या देश क े  खाद्य प्रसंस् कर ण उद्योग क े  कारखाने  प ंजीगत सहायता की कमी का सामना कर 
रहे  हैं और उस पर गैर संलगठत क्षेत्र का प्रभुत्व है  और यलद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है और 
इस संबंध में  सरकार ने  कौन-कौन से सुधारा त्मक उपाय लकये हैं; और   
(घ)  सरकार द्वारा देश में  खाद्य प्रसंस् करण  क्षेत्र की कायचक्षमता को बढ़ाने  क े  लल ए कौन -कौन से  
कदम उठाये गए हैं/उठाए जाने का प्रस्ताव है? 
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेली) 
 
(ि):   अनाज, फल , सब्जियां, डेयरी , मांस, मुगी पालन , समुद्री और मसाले क ु छ प्रमुख क ृ लि उत्पाद हैं 
लजन्हें देश में संसालधत लकया जाता है। इसक े  अलावा र े डी ट   ईट (आरटीई) और र े डी ट   क ु क 
(आरटीसी) उत्पाद भी प्रसंस् क ृत खाद्य उत् पाद की श्रेणी में आते हैं ।  
 
(ख):  नवीनतम अंतरराष्ट्र ीय आंकडों क े  अनुसार  विच 2019 में खाद्य उत्पादों क े  लवश् व क े  लनयाचत में 
भारतीय खाद्य उत्पादों क े  लनयाचत की भागीदारी 2.27 प्रलतशत थी। वैलिक खाद्य लनयाचत में भारत की 
भागीदारी में वृब्जि करने क े  ललए सरकार एक व्यापक क ृ लि लनयाचत नीलत को कायाचब्ज‍ वत कर रही है। 
क ृ लि एवं प्रसंस्क ृ त खाद्य उत्पाद लनयाचत लवकास प्रालधकरण, समुद्री उत्पाद लनयाचत लवकास प्रालधकरण 
स् कीम की लवत्तीय सहायता योजनाए ं  क ृ लि और समुद्री उत्पादों क े  लनयाचत को प्रोत् साहन देने क े  लल ए  
कायाचब्ज‍ वत की जा रही है। भारतीय लवलनमाचताओं को लवि स्तर पर प्रलतस्पधी बनाने , लनवेश आकलिचत
